speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: is the double vision constant or does it fluctuate, and does the weakness in your arms affect fine movements like buttoning a shirt?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text: That pattern of worsening weakness with activity and improvement with rest is very characteristic of myasthenia gravis, but I need to rule out other neuromuscular conditions. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_receptor_antibodies, Anti-MuSK_antibodies, and Creatine_kinase. REQUEST IMAGES: EMG_Neurophysiology.
